title: Szarr Family Ring
summary: Story ring unlocks Szarr Palace and Cazador’s Dungeon doors.

fields.Quest use: Obtain from Godey in the kennels for 95 XP and quest advancement, or loot Cazador. Opens applicable palace and dungeon doors. The palace’s Sinister Door also requires the Kozakuran Dictionary to read the inscription.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
